Policy
Many online services are provided under the County's Enhanced Access to Public Records Policy (PDF) and in compliance with the authority of the Enhanced Access to Public Records Act, 1996, P.A. 462. Many of the records are accessible to the public through one or more external service providers. Therefore, the currency of the records is subject to the business practices of each respective external service provider.
Clinton County makes no representations or warranties regarding the condition or functionality of this website, its suitability for use, or that this website will be uninterrupted or error-free. Users of any accessible online service is hereby notified that Clinton County assumes no responsibility or liability arising out of your use of this information and the website.
Due to the diverse nature of online services, requesting additional information about one or more services may require you to direct your questions to more than one County official. Refer to the departments listed next to each online service.
